plan: Evaluate each non-override requirement independently into an ID-keyed failure map.
Apply emergency overrides as a deterministic post-processing step, then sort explanations by requirement ID.
Reuse scalar evaluation for batch and hypothetical calls; compute emergency sensitivity from failed overridden IDs.

trace.target_mechanism: Each ordinary requirement produces an independent ID-keyed failure before emergency handling.
Failures and override explanations are combined by ID and rendered in sorted-ID order.
evaluate_with creates a shallow request copy and applies only the supplied replacements.
affected_by_emergency intersects currently failed requirement IDs with every configured override target set.
